data.title: Health insurance contribution increase from 1 January 2027
data.case_title: Health insurance contribution increase – Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that from 1 January 2027 her monthly voluntary health and long-term care insurance contribution rises to €318.46, due to a new additional contribution rate (Zusatzbeitragssatz) and her income according to her 2025 tax assessment.
data.explanation: Your statutory health insurer is raising your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027, because its additional contribution rate changed and based on your 2025 tax assessment income. The letter is collected automatically by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so no transfer is needed. If you disagree with the new amount, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the insurer; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final and the increased contribution applies. Keep this letter, since health insurance contributions are usually relevant for your tax return.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions are deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the German income tax return.
